items.title: KP / Strawberry Skin treatment
items.body: Targets keratosis pilaris — rough, bumpy 'strawberry skin' on arms and legs. The brand's defining concern.

home.title: Science-Backed Care for Keratosis Pilaris & Strawberry Skin
home.description: Improve keratosis pilaris, strawberry skin and dark spots with targeted formulas designed to smooth KP bumps and support even-looking skin.
home.fit: **Core skincare, strong fit, unusually sharp niche.** Keratosis pilaris is a specific, visible, under-served concern with a built-in visual demo and a named search term people already use. A concern-first site architecture ('Pick one and we'll do the rest') maps almost one-to-one onto hook segmentation. Best niche fit of this batch. Claim caution: eczema is a medical condition — the copy hedges with 'support' and 'designed to', and creative must keep that hedge.
